newApi.title: New API
newApi.intro: Describe what you want. Scrapyomama investigates the site, proposes an output schema, then tries the cheapest methods first.
newApi.descriptionHint: For example: the title, price and link of each listing.
newApi.urlInvalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
newApi.exampleInvalid: The example is not valid JSON (an object or an array).

network.dcProxy: Server proxy defined by your admin
network.resProxy: Residential proxy, billed per GB. Reserved for network reasons (country, connection errors). It is not used after a refusal.
network.country: Country of the residential proxy (2 letters)
network.tunnel: Run from my browser (my session, my IP); a verification will hand control back to me
network.atLeastOne: Choose at least one network mode.

account.declare: This site asks for an account
account.title: This site asks for an account
account.warning: This site asks for an account. Your terms of use of the platform may forbid automated extraction, and the data may concern people (GDPR). You are responsible for this use.
account.ownSession: Only your own session is used, never another person's.
account.confirm: I understand and I am responsible for this use

newApi.providerNoticeGeneric: The configured model provider will receive cleaned traffic excerpts.
newApi.countryInvalid: Enter a country code of 2 letters, for example fr.
newApi.descriptionRequired: Describe what the API should return.
newApi.accountRequired: Confirm the notice above to continue.
newApi.descriptionTemplate: A good request reads: “I want [what] from [where] to [what for].”

seen.empty: Nothing seen yet. The access check comes first.

controls.paused: Paused. Nothing new is tried until you resume.
controls.stopped: Investigation stopped. Trials and cost so far are kept: {cost}.
controls.followSuspended: Live updates suspended. New trials are not shown or announced.

log.title: Trials
log.robotsAbsent: robots.txt not found: no rule applies
log.robotsUnreachable: robots.txt unreachable: to be safe, nothing is collected

plan.title: The trial plan
plan.hint: Cheapest first. SYM stops at the first one that works.
plan.atLeastOne: At least one method must stay selected.
plan.empty: The trial plan appears here as soon as the server announces it.

stop.title: Intentional stop
stop.text: If the site refuses access, shows a verification or asks robots to stay away, SYM stops here. Nothing else is tried.

fetch_in_page.title: In-page fetch
fetch_in_page.text: the page's own requests, from a browser

playwright.title: Browser
playwright.text: if the page is built with JavaScript

agent_fetch.title: Agent + fetch
agent_fetch.text: the AI reads the HTML on every run

hybrid.title: Script + agent
hybrid.text: a script, and the agent when it gets stuck

agent.title: Agent
agent.text: as a last resort, then compiled

schema.title: Output schema
schema.editInvalid: This is not a valid JSON object.
schema.waiting: Check the proposed schema, then validate it or edit it.
schema.tunnelNote: Works only while your computer is on.
schema.empty: The schema will appear here once the reconnaissance is done.
schema.gateTitle: Here is what you are going to get
schema.fieldsCaption: Fields of the output schema: name, type and a real example from the sample
schema.remarkHint: Optional. Your note stays on this screen and goes nowhere: to change a field, use “Edit the schema”.

result.sain: The investigation succeeded. Your API is ready.
result.warning: The investigation ended with a warning. The strategy works but needs attention.
result.erreur: The investigation ended in error. The trial list shows why.
result.bloquee: The investigation stopped: the site refuses automated access.

gate.title: I found {what}. Shall we validate this schema?
gate.noTrial: No trial starts before your approval.
gate.spentUnknown: Already spent on the reconnaissance: not available yet.
gate.replay: Replays after that: about {cost}, no AI.
gate.auto: Schema validated automatically, as you asked.
gate.replayWithAi: Replays after that: about {cost}, with the AI on every run.

blocked.title: Blocked: {domain} refuses automated access

what.heading: What happened
what.protection: On {date}, trial {n} (“{execution}”, {network}), {domain} answered with a verification page. No other trial was started. Investigation cost: {cost}.
what.forbidden: On {date}, trial {n} (“{execution}”, {network}), {domain} answered with an access refusal. No other trial was started. Investigation cost: {cost}.
what.robots: {domain} asks robots not to visit this page. No request was sent to this path. Investigation cost: {cost}.
what.generic: {domain} refused access. No other trial was started. Investigation cost: {cost}.

why.heading: Why we stop
why.protection: This is the decision of the site. Scrapyomama does not answer in place of a person and does not change IP address after a refusal.
why.forbidden: The site refuses access to this address. The IP address does not change after a refusal. Check your access rights or contact the publisher.
why.robots: This site asks robots not to visit this page. Scrapyomama respects this rule.

todo.heading: What you can do
todo.official: Look for an official API, an export or a partnership.
todo.contact: Write to the publisher of the site.
todo.later: Investigate again later, if the site has changed.

auth_required.title: Connect {domain}
auth_required.body: The site asks for a sign-in. Connect it with the extension; the session shows up here as soon as it is connected.

cookie_expired.title: Connect {domain}
cookie_expired.body: The session has expired. Connect the site again with the extension.

session_device_bound.title: The session of {domain} cannot be copied to the server
session_device_bound.body: This session is tied to your device. Choose to run from your browser.

proxy_required.title: Add a proxy
proxy_required.body: This API needs a proxy for the requested country. Ask an admin to add one, then test it.

tunnel_offline.title: Your computer is not connected
tunnel_offline.body: This API runs from your browser. Open the extension and check its state.

challenge_in_tunnel.title: {domain} shows a verification in your browser; the run is stopped
challenge_in_tunnel.body: The run is stopped: {domain} shows a verification in your browser. Nothing was sent on this page and nothing will be. You can start a new run later; Scrapyomama never answers a verification.

secret_unreadable.title: A saved key is unreadable
secret_unreadable.body: Enter the key again in the settings, then test it.

payment_required.title: {domain} asks for a payment: {offer}
payment_required.body: Only the publisher of the site can give access. Nothing is retried automatically.

account_limit.title: {platform} flagged a limit on your account
account_limit.body: {platform} flagged a limit or a restriction. The run is stopped and no retry is planned. Read the messages of the platform. Only the platform decides on a restriction. Reminder: automated extraction may be forbidden by its terms, even with a single account; you remain responsible.

runs.title: All runs
runs.intro: Runs of your APIs, newest first. You see state, cost and duration, never the content of another member's run.
runs.caption: Runs, newest first

empty.title: No run yet

runs.other: Another member's run: state, cost and duration only

settings.title: Settings

secret.set: A secret is saved. Leave this field empty to keep it.

extension.pairingHelp: The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Enter it in the extension.

diagnostic.intro: Exports a JSON file on this computer with the versions and the state of the instance. Nothing is sent anywhere.
diagnostic.includes: The file holds: instance version, schema version, minimum extension version, MCP specification version, readiness, console language. It never holds a key, a cookie or a run content.

request.template:
Hello,

I would like to access the data of {domain} in an automated way, while respecting your access rules. Is there an official API, an export or a partnership agreement?

Thank you in advance.

connect.title: Connect {domain}
connect.verify: The session shows up here as soon as the extension sends it (live update).

deviceBound.title: The session on {domain} cannot be copied to the server
deviceBound.button: Choose to run from my browser
deviceBound.verify: The extension state is updated live.

proxy.title: Add a proxy for {country}
proxy.verify: Use the Test button in the settings to check the proxy.

tunnelOffline.title: Your computer is not connected
tunnelOffline.verify: The connection state is updated live.

challenge.title: {domain} shows a verification in your browser; the run is stopped
challenge.text: Nothing was sent on this page and nothing will be. You can run again later; Scrapyomama never answers a verification.
challenge.verify: No automatic resume: only a new action from you starts a run.

secret.title: A stored key is unreadable
secret.verify: Use the Test button to check the new key.

accountLimit.title: {platform} flagged a limit on your account

estimate.known: Usual cost: {cost}, median of {n} run | Usual cost: {cost}, median of {n} runs

schemas.editUnavailable: The output can only be changed when the API is Healthy or To watch, because the change starts a re-investigation.
schemas.invalid: The JSON entered is not a valid object.

confirm.title: Change the output schema?

schemas.viewsHint: The displayed columns (views) are distinct from the output schema.

strategy.validated: Validated on {n} sample | Validated on {n} samples

revertConfirm.title: Go back to v{v}?

revertConfirm.preview: Preview of the changes, from v{from} (current) to v{to}
revertConfirm.previewUnavailable: Preview of the changes unavailable for now.

diff.title: Comparison of v{from} and v{to}
diff.rawCaption: Raw diff between v{from} and v{to}

runsTab.retention: Runs kept {n} day by default | Runs kept {n} days by default

states.skipped_overlap: Skipped: a run is already in progress

runsTab.relaunchUnavailable: The input of this run cannot be read again. Run the API from the overview.

schedules.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
schedules.inputHint: The dated variables today and yesterday are accepted between double braces.
schedules.inputInvalid: The JSON entered is not a valid object.
schedules.overlapLabel: If the previous run is not finished
schedules.onlyIfOnline: Only if the computer is connected
schedules.skipHint: A schedule does not call a site whose API is in error, action required or blocked.

accessTab.noReport: No access report for this API yet.

robotsStatuses.unreachable: Unreachable (as a precaution, nothing is collected)

accessTab.robotsAlways: robots.txt is always respected: no setting can ignore it.

replay.title: Investigation replay

setup.title: Set up your instance
setup.intro: Create the owner account. This wizard works once: when the owner exists, this page disappears.
setup.tokenHint: The value of ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN from the deployment. It is never shown again.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Pasting is fine, and a long phrase works well.
setup.signInFailed: The owner account was created, but signing in failed. Sign in from the sign-in page.

errors.forbidden: The token or the address is not accepted.
errors.weak_password: This password is not accepted. Use at least 12 characters and avoid common passwords.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalid_instance_contact: This contact is not valid. Use a web address (https://…), a mailto: link or an e-mail address, with no spaces or line breaks.

done.title: Owner account created
done.onlyOnce: The fingerprint is shown only now. Note it, so that you can check later that the same key is in use.
done.reminder: Back up MASTER_KEY outside this platform. Without it, the encrypted secrets can never be read again.
done.acknowledge: I saved MASTER_KEY outside this platform

next.title: Connect what the instance needs
next.intro: Each page has a Test button. Do them in this order, or later.
next.models: AI models: the provider and the key used to investigate sites.
next.proxies: Proxies: only if some sites need a network route.

setup.contactHint: Optional here, needed before the first investigation. A web address (https://…) or an e-mail address. The robot announces it only if you turn on identification in Settings. You can change it there later.

account.title: My account
account.intro: Your sign-in, your second factor, your sessions and your activity.

codes.password_reset_by_operator: A reset link was issued for your account by the operator of the server on {date}. If this was not you or an admin you know, change your password below and close your other sessions.
codes.password_reset_withheld: A reset link by e-mail was held back on {date}, because an admin changed the e-mail relay less than 24 hours earlier and your account has no second factor.

preferences.title: Language, theme and animations
preferences.text: Use the language and theme controls at the top of the page. They are saved with your account.
preferences.motionHint: Reduced turns off every non-essential movement. This choice is kept in this browser.

password.title: Password
password.intro: Changing it needs your current password. Your open sessions stay open: you can close the others afterwards.
password.newHint: At least 12 characters. Pasting is fine, and a long phrase works well.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are different.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app is asked after your password. E-mail and SMS are not used.
twoFactor.enforced: This instance requires two-factor authentication for your role.
twoFactor.passwordHint: Leave it empty if you sign in only with SSO and your last sign-in is recent.
twoFactor.seedTitle: Add this key to your authenticator app
twoFactor.seedHelp: Choose manual entry in the app and type the key. It is shown only now.
twoFactor.backupHelp: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.regenerateHelp: Needs your password and a current code. The old codes stop working.
twoFactor.disableHelp: Needs your password and a current code.
twoFactor.removalBlocked: This instance requires two-factor authentication for your role: it cannot be removed. You can still regenerate your backup codes.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.intro: The places where you are signed in. Close the ones you do not recognize.
sessions.caption: Your open sessions

closeOthers.title: Close your other sessions?
closeOthers.count: You still have {n} other open session. | You still have {n} other open sessions.
closeOthers.text: If you made this change because you are not sure who uses your account, close your other sessions. This one stays open.

identities.title: Single sign-on
identities.intro: Identities linked to your account. Linking asks for your password again.
identities.caption: Linked identities

twoFactorSetup.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
twoFactorSetup.intro: This instance requires it for your role. Finish this step to use the console.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Keys identify you to the REST API and to MCP. Each one has scopes and an expiry date. The secret appears once, when the key is created.
keys.label: Label
keys.labelHint: For example the name of the tool that uses it.
keys.scopesHint: A key can only do what its scopes allow, on your own data.

scope.sites:read: Read the state of connected sites (never cookies)

keys.expiresHint: 90 days by default. The instance sets a maximum.
keys.passwordHint: Leave it empty if you sign in only with SSO and your last sign-in is recent.

created.title: Copy this key now
created.text: It will not be shown again. Store it in a secret manager.

keys.caption: Your API keys
keys.revokeConsequence: Tools that use "{label}" lose access right away. This cannot be undone.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Invite people, set roles, disable accounts. You see accounts and metadata only: never the content of someone else's runs, datasets or cookies.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.emailHint: The link works only for this exact address, once, for 48 hours.
invite.emailed: An e-mail with the link was sent to {email}.
invite.linkHelp: No e-mail is set up, so copy this link and send it to the person yourself. It is shown only now.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.caption: Invitations
invitations.revokeConsequence: The link sent to {email} stops working.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.caption: Accounts of the instance
accounts.name: Account
accounts.ownerNoActions: The owner cannot be changed here.

confirm.disableConsequence: Sessions are closed, keys and tunnel tokens are revoked, server-side cookies are deleted and schedules are paused. Runs and datasets stay with the person.
confirm.deleteConsequence: Datasets, runs, APIs and site sessions of this account are deleted or made anonymous. The audit log keeps the identifier, not the data. This cannot be undone.
confirm.revokeAccessConsequence: All sessions are closed and all API keys and tunnel tokens are revoked. The account stays active. You do not see or use any of them.
confirm.resetTwoFactorConsequence: The sessions are closed and the person must set up two-factor authentication again. The action is logged.
confirm.resetLinkConsequence: All sessions of the account are closed. The link needs the person's second factor. You never choose a password for someone.
confirm.roleConsequence: The new role applies at the next request of the person.

resetLink.title: Reset link for {name}
resetLink.help: Send this link to the person. It works once and asks for their second factor. It is shown only now.
resetLink.note: A copyable link exists only when e-mail is not set up and the account has two-factor authentication. Otherwise, use the server command (see the guide).

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.intro: The new owner gets every owner right and you become an admin. Needs your password and a 6-digit code.
transfer.confirmConsequence: This changes who controls the instance.

audit.title: Audit
audit.intro: Administration actions and sign-in events. It holds metadata only: no secret, no cookie, no dataset content, no tool arguments.

filters.actionHint: Exact action code, for example user.deactivated.

audit.caption: Audit events

action.apikey_first_use: API key used for the first time
action.auth_login_rate_limit_waived: Sign-in limit waived for a known device

security.title: Instance security
security.intro: Session lengths, allowed e-mail domains and limits. Only the owner can change them.
security.idle: Idle time before a session ends (minutes)
security.domainsHint: One per line. Empty means every domain.

identity.title: Robot identity
identity.intro: How the robot introduces itself to the sites it reads. By default it sends the real User-Agent of its embedded browser and nothing more.
identity.userAgentHint: The real User-Agent of the embedded Chromium, the same for every run of this image. It is shown for information and cannot be edited here.
identity.userAgentUnknown: No worker has reported its browser yet. It appears once a worker has started.
identity.identified: User-Agent sent while identification is on
identity.identifiedHint: The same string followed by the instance token and your contact. This is what sites see once you turn identification on and save.
identity.identify: Identify this instance to the sites it reads
identity.identifyHint: Off by default. When on, the User-Agent ends with the instance token (“compatible; Scrapyomama”, its version and your contact), and an e-mail contact is also sent in the From header. It applies to the next run.
identity.identifyUnset: Never set here: the worker uses its IDENTIFY_INSTANCE variable, and identification stays off if that is not set either.
identity.identifyFromEnvOn: Not set here: the worker’s IDENTIFY_INSTANCE variable turns identification on, so the box is ticked. Untick it and save to turn it off for this instance.
identity.identifyFromEnvOff: Not set here: the worker’s IDENTIFY_INSTANCE variable turns identification off. Tick the box and save to turn it on for this instance.
identity.contactHint: Who runs this instance: a web address (https://…), a mailto: link or an e-mail address. No spaces or line breaks. Empty it and save to remove it.
identity.contactUnset: Not set here: the worker uses its INSTANCE_CONTACT variable. A contact is needed before the first investigation.
identity.contactFromEnv: Not set here: the worker announces its INSTANCE_CONTACT variable, {contact}. Type a contact and save to replace it.

sso.title: Single sign-on (OIDC)
sso.intro: One identity provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Google, Entra). Accounts are matched by issuer and subject, never by e-mail.
sso.label: Button label
sso.requiredHint: Local passwords stop working, except the owner's emergency local sign-in.
sso.jitHint: Off by default. Needs at least one allowed domain. New accounts are members.
sso.groupsHint: Default is member. The owner role is never given.
